title: Image
description: Digital image record associated with an Object. Contains technical metadata, rights information, and access details.

id.description: Unique identifier for this image record.

object_id.description: Reference to the parent Object this image belongs to.

file.description: Local file path relative to the assets directory (e.g., images/acervo/BR-009.webp).

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the image file for integrity verification.

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the image file in bytes.

width_px.description: Width of the image in pixels.

height_px.description: Height of the image in pixels.

source_url.description: URL to the source image at the holding institution or archive.

iiif_manifest.description: URL to IIIF manifest for this image.

iiif_service.description: URL to IIIF image service endpoint.

license.description: License under which the image is made available.

rights_status.description: Rights status determining how the image can be used.

rights_evidence_url.description: URL to the rights statement or evidence documentation.

credit.description: Required credit line for the image.

alt_text.description: Descriptive alt text for accessibility. Must be non-interpretive, describing only what is visible.

is_primary.description: Whether this is the primary representative image for the object.

sequence.description: Sequence number for ordering multiple images of the same object.

created_at.description: When this image record was created.

updated_at.description: When this image record was last updated.
